title: Studio: edit a read-only package's views, dashboards and reports in place — overlay draft, "customized in this environment" chip, Reset to package default (ADR-0146 D2; #28130 child 2a)
body:
director#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaRN6wdrRyLKJSCMYH

Filing gate: ADR-0146 merged into `main` as `cdbf08d1` (PR #28045, 2026-10-30T13:55Z), which lifts epic #28130's ⛔ "no child card before the merge"; the maintainer's word for the epic is 「同意，立专题卡」 (13:22Z). ⛔ Not a claim — this card waits in its lane's queue.

Part of #28130 (phase 2, child **2a**) · governs: ADR-0146 D2 · lane: `domain:ui` · size: M.

**Business reason.** A customer who installs HotCRM (a code package, read-only in Studio) and wants one column added to the Accounts list view today has two doors: Studio shows the view greyed, and Setup → Metadata's item page is the only place the overlay can be written — a second designer with a second save model (row 13 of #27356 put a link there, PR #27927, only when an overlay already exists). ADR-0146 D2 rules **one editor per item**: the overlay is edited where the item is designed, in Studio, on the read-only package itself.

**Measured (main `cdbf08d1`).**
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/**`: the Interfaces pillar renders a read-only package's items without an editor; `useStudioDesignGate` (objectui#12615) opens the browse entry for read-only packages since PR #28076.
- Overlay-able types in `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY`: view, dashboard, report, translation, email_template (ADR-0005 tier).
- Setup's `views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` already writes the overlay row and offers Reset through `client.reset` → `DELETE /meta/:type/:name`, with the honest tri-state `layered.resettable` (objectui#4886) deciding whether the verb is Reset or Delete.
- The row-13 link (PR #27927) sends the Studio reader to that Setup page.

**Wanted.**
1. On a read-only package, the Interfaces pillar's view / dashboard / report items open in their designer **editable**; the draft writes the overlay row (same door Setup uses today), publish applies it; no new server door.
2. The item shows a **"customized in this environment"** chip read from the layered envelope (served fact, nothing computed client-side), in the rail and in the designer header.
3. **Reset to package default** on the item menu, through the existing `DELETE /meta/:type/:name`, with the verb taken from `layered.resettable` exactly as Setup's page does; confirm first; a pending draft of the item is discarded before the reset.
4. Retire the row-13 "edit the overlay in Setup" link once 1–3 render; translation and email_template follow in a later card (ADR-0146 open question 3 — a simplified form editor — is the maintainer's to answer first).
5. Tests: the pillar renders editable on a read-only package for the three types; chip present only when the served envelope says overlaid; Reset verb follows the tri-state; a writable package is unchanged.

**Not here.** The paired `<base>.customize` package (2d/2e); flows (2b); any change to the overlay tier (ADR-0005).

**Dedupe.** #27356 row 13 (landed as the link this card retires); #27927; objectui#4886 (the tri-state). No open `area:studio` card offers in-place overlay editing.

Links back: ADR-0146 D2 and §9-lift paragraph, ADR-0126 §9 first bullet, #28130, #27356.
